what: Petals float slowly up from the bottom of the screen and drift (three.js orthographic camera). Back layer: one petal per 400px of spacing (seven at 1440, size 10~20x, rising .8~1.5px per frame), placed mixed among eight edge-side slots (±.64~1 screen half-width). Front layer: two petals (±.75, 25~33x, 1.7~2.2px) blurred by a nine-tap horizontal and vertical Gauss (1.5/1000) so they look like they pass in front of a lens. Each petal has z rotation (±.006) and x·y sway (sin), and rises faster by the amount scrolled (back .35, front .5 times). Front petals within 200px of the cursor are pushed outward, away from the side where the petal sits, by (200−distance)×.02, then settle by .99 per frame. Past 500 above, a petal re-stands below at its original x.

options.layer: With front, the front layer (two sheets · blur · cursor push), otherwise the back layer
options.count: Number of leaves — if absent, the original formula (back: 3000/400, phone screen height×1.5/250 · front: 2)
options.push: Radius (px) the cursor pushes — front layer default 200, back layer 0
options.blur: Blur step distance (ratio of screen width) — front layer default .0015 (double on phone), 0 means no blur
options.narrow: Below this width (px) uses phone values (small leaves, slow), default 768
options.watch: Runs only while this section is visible — nearest ancestor css, default section
options.--fx-petal · --fx-petal-edge: (css variable) leaf color and the dark color at the bottom, default --kf-bg · --kf-line

use: …

from.where: index.html .lw-petals (behind the Service section #canvas-top-back · front #canvas-top-front — original three r160 leaf TP class: spacing 400/800, size 10~20·25~33, rise .8~1.5·1.7~2.2, scroll .35·.5, cursor 200·.02·.99, front layer Horizontal/VerticalBlurShader 1.5/1000)

note: The original leaves are photo textures — here the parts are plates made of a cherry blossom petal outline (Shape) with two skin-color gradients. Blur is drawn onto a screen plate as in the original, then blurred twice (horizontal · vertical) with a shader. three is loaded in the order three-global.js → three@0.160.0/build/three.cjs instead of three.min.js (the min build gives an outdated-build warning from r150).
